turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail: ormally take to ship and send a tracking number?Agent saidMost orders are processed within 2–3 business days, and you'll receive a tracking email as soon as your package ships. Once shipped, delivery typically takes 4–10 business days depending on your location. If your order includes multiple items, they might ship separately, and you'll get individual tracking numbers for each shipment.If you have any other questions or want to check your specific order, just let me know once you've logged in!
